# Upstream components

`diff/` is copied unchanged from [DSH-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar), commit `1fcf43ccbedd6e66370b7fb81df2b4dd0ef2604e`, `src/client/diff/`. `locales.ts` replaces the host translation dependency.

`theme/design-platform.css` is copied unchanged from [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), commit `c291e7961a515f6d7af9304e7fd1d257929aef26`, `packages/client/ui-theme/src/styles/`.

Both are MIT licensed; each directory includes its upstream license. The shell and Pi adapter are PiAstra code. This is a selective port, not a DSH plugin host or an official DeepSeek product.
